title: Medusa
summary: Medusa is a rare and coveted Krono-Titan that terrorized Ancient Greece. With a human-like torso and the tail of a serpent, her hair forms a large snake head and, like King Basilisk, she can turn her enemies to stone with her gaze. An exceptionally volatile and unruly Titan, no Seeker had been successful in taming Medusa for two thousand years.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Medusa inspired the Greek myth of the Gorgon, a monster with snakes for hair which could turn its onlookers to stone. In the legends, there were three Gorgon sisters, with stories saying they shared a single eye between them. [Zhalia's Mission] Medusa's Amulet was eventually hidden away in a cave on an isolated island in the Aegean Sea, and was believed by many modern Seekers to be missing since the time of the ancient Greeks. [Zhalia's Mission]

Many centuries later, Medusa's location was tracked down by the Organization. However, Wilder planned for his right-hand man, Stack to obtain the Amulet and offer it to the Blood Spiral in order to join and infiltrate the group for his own end. Although the Huntik Foundation team successfully intercepted and defeated Wilder's forces on the shores of the island, Stack and the ruthless Blood Spiral warrior Kiel reached the cave first, and Stack invoked the cave's mechanism to call out Medusa. In an attempt to counter her Stonegaze ability, he invoked Divine Mirror Kagami. However, Medusa's raw aggression and volatile temperament proved far more difficult to subdue than he anticipated, rapidly breaking Kagami's mirror. At that moment, the Huntik team launched an offensive on Kiel and his forces. 

During the battle, Lok Lambert, Zhalia Moon, and Cherit worked to solve the cave's ancient puzzle of the Gorgon sisters. Zhalia informed Lok that the sculptures of the three creatures were Gorgon sisters who shared a single eye. Upon noticing that the light could travel between the stones in the Gorgons' eye sockets, Zhalia and Cherit directed the remaining stones at Lok, who ordered Medusa to return. Upon defeating Kagami, Medusa obeyed and returned to the stone, which shattered, revealing her Amulet, which Lok safely recovered. [Zhalia's Mission]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E35 Medusa 1.png|thumb|Medusa attempts to use her '''Stonegaze''' ability]]
Medusa's feral and aggressive nature makes her an incredibly difficult Titan to subdue. She can move swiftly to dodge attacks while clawing and slashing at enemies with her razor-sharp claws. She possesses the same '''Stonegaze''' ability as [[King Basilisk]], allowing her to turn people and [[Titans]] into stone. {{Source|S2E35}} She was able to singlehandedly defeat [[Divine Mirror Kagami]] and dodge attacks from [[Stack]]. {{Source|S2E35}}

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* The inability of [[Divine Mirror Kagami]] to redirect Medusa's Stonegaze ability alludes to Greek mythology in which [[wikipedia:Medusa|Medusa's]] ability had no effect when it was reflected of a shiny surface. This would allow Kagami to block her ability but not completely redirect it.
*Zhalia states that the Gorgon sisters shared a single eye to solve the puzzle in Medusa's Cave. This is a creative departure from classical Greek mythology, where the Gorgons had individual eyes and it was actually their biological sisters, the Graeae, who shared a single eye between them.
